title: Body Temperature Dropped Below 98.6°F
hook: The classroom definition of normal no longer matches modern bodies.
closing: Knowing your own baseline helps you notice when your body is actually running hot.
question: What is your resting temperature?

segments.say: Modern men average 97.5 degrees. Today's bodies run cooler than the historic standard.
Men's average body temperature dropped 1.06 degrees. Their decline was larger than women's.
Recalculating the original thermometers produced 98.2 degrees. Even the famous baseline appears slightly too warm.
